items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 27:1
items.html: It does not intend the fixed Mochin in Atzilut, namely at the time that AVI clothe the HGT of AA and are in the stature of SAG, for then they do not need the Mazal to serve them as MAN, since they couple on their own MAN, which is from the aspect of restriction 2, as is known. Rather, it intends the time of the ascent of the Partzufim to additions of Mochin, which are drawn only from the revealed AB, as above in answer 148, see there. For then AA ascends to the GAR of Atik, and AVI to the GAR of AA, and then the screen and coarseness of AVI themselves are not sufficient for MAN, since they are from the aspect of the Malchut of restriction 2, and the revealed AB does not go out except through the MAN of the Malchut of restriction 1, as is known; therefore they need the MAN of the beard, whose source of their coarseness is from the aspect of the coarseness of the Malchut of restriction 1. And this matter is done through the ascent itself, for then AA receives, through his ascent to the GAR of Atik, the stature of the returning surrounding [light], and the hairs enter again into the Rosh and become internal; it is then found that also the Mazalot, which are the surrounding ones of the HGT of AA, enter also into the internality of his HGT, and then AVI can use these hairs of the Mazal as MAN, to draw from the stature of the revealed AB. For just as the Mazalot serve AVI in the aspect of their permanence as surrounding vessels, as above in answer 149, so at the time of the ascent they become for them internal, and they can use their MAN. And see all this in the Inner Observation here, where it is explained at length. (Vol. 1, p. 377, Item 173).
